The Phillip Edge

Our Edge

Why It Matters

Future Capital Market Access

Focus on companies expected to raise capital through IPOs, QIPs or other market issuances, driving stronger governance, transparency and valuation.

Well-Capitalised Promoters

Invest in businesses backed by financially strong promoter groups with the ability to support growth across market cycles.

Strong Business Moats

Prefer companies with established franchises, competitive advantages and resilient business models.

Rating Upgrade Potential

Identify issuers with improving fundamentals that could benefit from future credit rating upgrades.

Deep Issuer Relationships

Strong market access enables better sourcing, due diligence and investment opportunities.

Active Credit Monitoring

Continuous review of financials, business performance and market developments throughout the investment lifecycle.

Curated Opportunities, Not Performing Credit
